name: Quila
description: Quila was an aquatic planet located in the Rolion sector of the Outer Rim Territories that appeared blue from space. In 4 BBY, an Imperial freighter carrying Janard, a prisoner of the Empire and informant to the rebel Sabine Wren, crashed into Quila's oceans. Wren and her rebel allies Ahsoka Tano and Hera Syndulla tracked the freighter to Quila after Janard sent a distress call. While Syndulla piloted their ship, the Ghost, Wren and Tano donned SCUBA gear and ventured into the partially-submerged freighter to rescue Janard. They quickly located Janard, but while attempting to leave the ship, were confronted by Imperial forces. During a brief battle, Janard was mortally wounded by a stormtrooper and although the human perished, Wren and Tano escaped.

A species of eel lived in the oceans of Quila.
